entities.summary: Balakovo is a city in Saratov Oblast, Russia, located on the East bank of the Volga River about 131 kilometers (81 mi) northeast of Saratov, the administrative center of the oblast. Population: 199,690 (2010 census); 200,470 (2002 census); 197,391 (1989 Soviet census).
